messages:
maya: Quick note  we need a minimalist post-launch decision flow so CS/eng pick the same lane for bugs vs enhancements. Proposing: hotfix lane (urgent), sprint lane (fix next sprint), and 6-week maintenance slice for grouped enhancements. Keep it to one page.

drew: Yes — love the three-lane approach. Can we also include a short rubric for reclassifying (e.g., if a P1 needs >3 dev-days -> reclass to P2 unless SLA says otherwise)?

lin: Agree. Also recommend tagging by customer tier: Tier-A items (contractual SLA) auto-escalate. CS should tag at intake.

olivia: From eng: we want a required "quick-est" field before scheduling hotfix work (1line dev estimate + test impact). No estimate -> triage only, no immediate hotfix.

sam: Telemetry thresholds I'll wire: sustained error-rate >0.5% for 5m -> P1; customer-reported with reproducible data -> escalate to P0 if data loss. I'll add a Grafana panel and PD rule.

maya: Draft DoR/DoD bullets (short):
```
DoR: repro steps, customer impact, signal link, rough dev-estimate, owner
DoD: regression tests, release notes blurb, rollback plan or feature-flag toggle
```

drew: Good. For cadence: hotfix windows are ad-hoc; sprint lane handled during normal sprint planning; maintenance slice every 6 weeks with canary and rollback gates. Add feature-flags mandatory for maintenance.

olivia: I'll write a compact rollback checklist (kubectl rollback example + ff kill). Also propose reserving ~25% of dev capacity for reactive work for first 2 months post-launch. If exceeded, we pause non-critical roadmap work.

cs-bot: CS intake template reminder: https://redwood.internal/cs/intake (auto-post)

deploy-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/postlaunch-quickflow (auto-post)

maya: Actions: 1) lin -> customer-tier tagging snippet in intake by EOD; 2) drew -> quick-est template + reclass rule; 3) olivia -> rollback checklist & capacity note; 4) sam -> dashboard + PD rules. I'll assemble the one-pager and post for review tomorrow.

lin: Confirmed. I'll also add automatic ping to the CS owner for Tier-A items.

drew: Confirmed. I'll draft the quick-est template and paste into the tracker.

olivia: Confirmed. Checklist will include canary %, smoke test commands, and how to abort.

sam: Confirmed. Will add weekly top-5 regression digest to #product-telemetry.

maya: Nice  if no blockers I'll publish the one-pager after reviews. Tracker stub: https://redwood.internal/trackers/postlaunch-mini-1766667000 (created).

drew: No blockers.

maya: Closing loop  drop edge-cases here and I'll fold into the handbook doc.
